name: Invoice Payment – PDF Invoices, Packing Slips, Shipping Labels & Pay by Invoice for WooCommerce
author: BeautifulPlugins

sections.description:
Invoice Payment creates every document a WooCommerce store needs — PDF invoices, packing slips, delivery notes, shipping labels and dispatch labels — and lets customers pay by invoice at checkout, with due dates, a Pay Now link and payment reminders.

Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu work out of the box: documents switch to right-to-left automatically, with fonts that join Arabic script correctly. No add-on needed.

🚀 Explore Invoice Payment | 📄 Documentation | 💻 Support

Who is it for?

  • Every WooCommerce store that wants a professional WooCommerce PDF invoice in the order email and in My Account, without paying per document.
  • Warehouses and fulfilment teams who print packing slips, delivery notes and shipping labels in bulk.
  • B2B and wholesale stores whose customers pay by invoice — net 14 or net 30, with a PO number and their VAT number on the invoice.
  • Stores selling in Arabic, Hebrew, Persian or Urdu, or in Saudi Arabia (ZATCA QR) and the EU (UBL, Peppol, SEPA QR, reverse charge).
  • Stores leaving another invoice plugin, who want to keep their invoice numbers.

Documents

  • PDF invoices with sequential numbers, invoice and due dates, a paid / overdue stamp and your bank details.
  • Packing slips with a tick box per item, SKU, weight and the customer note.
  • Delivery notes with “received by” and signature lines.
  • Shipping labels (4×6 in, 4×4 in, 100×150 mm, A6) with sender, recipient, tracking number and barcode.
  • Dispatch labels for the warehouse: large order number, barcode and item checklist.
  • Print or download one document, or bulk print a whole selection of orders as one PDF.
  • Attach any document to any WooCommerce email.

Beautiful, right-to-left ready templates

  • Three templates — Modern, Classic and Minimal — with your logo, accent colour, font and paper size (A4, Letter, Legal, A5).
  • Live preview on the settings page with a real order.
  • Built-in RTL for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu, Eastern Arabic digits, Hijri dates and labels in two languages side by side.
  • One-click font packs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Indic scripts, Khmer and Burmese.
  • Override any template from your theme.

Get invoices paid

  • Pay by invoice at checkout, on the classic checkout and the Checkout block.
  • Payment terms and due dates, a Pay Now link on the invoice and in emails, and invoice statuses: unpaid, sent, paid, overdue, void.
  • Restrict the gateway by order total, country, customer role or to logged-in customers.
  • Automatic overdue detection and a payment reminder email.
  • An Invoices tab in My Account with the status, due date and a Pay Now button.
  • Purchase order and VAT number fields at checkout.

Compliance

  • Sequential numbers that never repeat, with prefix, suffix, padding and a yearly restart.
  • UBL 2.1 and Peppol BIS 3.0 e-invoices (XML).
  • SEPA payment QR code (EPC / GiroCode) and the ZATCA QR code for Saudi tax invoices.
  • Tax summary by rate and the reverse-charge note.

Easy to switch

Import the settings and existing invoice numbers of PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce (WP Overnight) or WebToffee PDF Invoices in one click. Nothing is changed in the other plugin.

Works with

  • WooCommerce 7.0+ — classic checkout, Checkout block, HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).
  • Any theme — documents are rendered on your server, not by the theme.
  • Shipment tracking plugins — the tracking number is printed on shipping labels (WooCommerce Shipment Tracking, Advanced Shipment Tracking).
  • EU VAT plugins — the customer’s VAT number is picked up automatically.
  • WooCommerce Product Bundles, Dokan and multi-currency plugins — documents always show the currency the customer paid in.

Invoice Payment Pro

Invoice Payment Pro adds the documents accountants ask for and the tools that get invoices paid:

  • Proforma invoices, credit notes (issued automatically on refunds), payment receipts, pick lists and address labels.
  • Eight premium templates — Corporate, Elegant, Bold, Boutique, Tech, Arabic Classic, Bilingual and Thermal 80 mm — and a section builder.
  • Custom fields from order, customer or product meta, and multilingual documents (WPML, Polylang, TranslatePress).
  • Credit limits, customer approval and per-customer payment terms for pay by invoice.
  • Partial payments, late fees, reminder schedules before and after the due date, and statements of account.
  • Factur-X / ZUGFeRD, XRechnung and CII e-invoices.
  • ZIP exports, reports (ageing, top debtors, tax by rate, CSV), extra email recipients, webhooks and a REST API.

External Services

= Font packs (GitHub) =
Fonts for Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, Hebrew, Arabic, Persian and Urdu ship with the plugin. When a store owner clicks Install next to a font pack under WooCommerce → Invoices → Templates (or runs wp ipay fonts install), the font files are downloaded once from GitHub (raw.githubusercontent.com, the font folder of the open-source mPDF project) and checked against a SHA-256 checksum. Nothing is sent to GitHub except the request for the file. Nothing is downloaded unless the store owner asks for it. GitHub Terms of Service · GitHub Privacy Statement

WooCommerce

This plugin extends WooCommerce and stores its data in your own WordPress database. It does not send order or customer data to any other service.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. A short setup wizard asks for your logo, documents, template and email settings. Every step can be skipped.
  3. Fine-tune everything under WooCommerce → Invoices.
  4. To let customers pay by invoice, enable the gateway under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Invoice Payment.
sections.faq:
I already use the Invoice Payment gateway. What changes when I update to 1.3.0?

Nothing, until you decide. Your gateway settings are kept, and on stores that update, no document is attached to emails and no new My Account tab appears until you switch them on under WooCommerce → Invoices.

Do Arabic and Hebrew invoices need an add-on?

No. Right-to-left layout and the fonts for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu are built in. The direction follows your site language, or you can force it under Templates.

Can I keep my invoice numbers from another plugin?

Yes. WooCommerce → Invoices → Tools imports the settings and existing invoice numbers of WP Overnight’s and WebToffee’s invoice plugins.

Where are the PDFs stored?

In a private folder inside your uploads directory that cannot be opened directly. Documents are always delivered through a permission check: store staff, the customer who placed the order, or a signed link that expires.

Can I change the template?

Yes. Pick a template, colour and font under Templates, add custom CSS, or copy any file from templates/ to yourtheme/woocommerce/ to change it completely.

Can I bulk print invoices and packing slips?

Yes. Select orders in WooCommerce → Orders and choose “Print: Invoice” (or any document) to get one PDF with a page per order. Each order also has print buttons in the orders list.

Can customers download their invoices?

Yes. Turn on the Invoices tab under WooCommerce → Invoices → Settings → Customer access. Customers see every invoice with its status and due date, download it and pay unpaid invoices online.

Does it create credit notes for refunds?

Credit notes, proforma invoices and receipts are part of Invoice Payment Pro. Credit notes are issued automatically when you refund an order.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. Every feature described above is free. Invoice Payment Pro adds more documents and invoice-management tools.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or newer
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer with the mbstring and GD extensions
sections.changelog:
1.3.0 (16th November 2026)

  • New: PDF invoices, packing slips, delivery notes, shipping labels and dispatch labels.
  • New: Modern, Classic and Minimal templates with logo, colour, font, paper size and a live preview.
  • New: Built-in right-to-left support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu, Eastern Arabic digits, Hijri dates and bilingual labels.
  • New: Font packs for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Indic scripts, Khmer and Burmese.
  • New: Invoice statuses, due dates, Pay Now link, overdue detection and a payment reminder email.
  • New: Invoice email, documents attached to WooCommerce emails and an Invoices tab in My Account.
  • New: Gateway restrictions by order total, country, role and login; order status after checkout; PO and VAT number fields.
  • New: Sequential numbering with format, padding and yearly restart.
  • New: UBL 2.1 and Peppol BIS 3.0 e-invoices, SEPA (EPC) and ZATCA QR codes, tax summary and reverse-charge note.
  • New: Bulk printing, an Invoices overview, a Documents list, a dashboard widget, Site Health checks and WP-CLI commands.
  • New: Import from PDF Invoices & Packing Slips (WP Overnight) and WebToffee PDF Invoices.
  • New: Setup wizard, settings import / export and privacy exporter / eraser.
  • Compatibility: Your existing gateway settings are kept, and nothing new is sent to customers until you switch it on.

1.1.4 (21st August 2026)

  • Compatibility: Make the plugin compatible with WooCommerce 11.0 and WordPress 7.1.

1.1.1 (17th July 2026)

  • Fix: Fixed few known issues and bugs.
  • Compatibility: Make the plugin compatible with WooCommerce 10.9

1.1.0 (21st June 2026)

  • New: Added new plugin icon.
  • Compatibility: Make the plugin compatible with WooCommerce 10.8 and WordPress 7.0.

1.0.1 (13th February 2026)

  • Compatibility: Make the plugin compatible with WooCommerce 10.5 and WordPress 6.9.

1.0.0 (8th February 2025)

  • Initial Release
